artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 3]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a central large fruit with flowers and foliage branching from it. Surrounding objects include a frog, a fly, a moth, cherries, a ribbon, and a circular item. The monochromatic etching features shades of brown and black. A flower with broad petals is on the left, a moth near the top right, a frog at the bottom, and an insect resembling a bee to the right. Handwritten text is along the bottom.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 4]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a central potato with a flower stem, surrounded by insects and flowers. The color scheme is black and white, and the elements are arranged across the page in a scattered pattern.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 5]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features a detailed slug at the bottom center, a large butterfly on the left connected to a flower, and various other insects and botanical elements such as a shell, a hornet, and flowers. The color palette is monochromatic, using only black ink on a beige background resembling an engraving. The slug is at the bottom center, the butterfly is on the left with small flowers, and on the right, a hornet and spider are placed near floral arrangements. Latin text is located just below the central elements. Various insects and fruits are spread throughout the composition, adding to the intricate details.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 6]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image consists of a variety of objects including a large butterfly, an apple, a flower with distinct petals, a crawfish with open claws, and a spherical object resembling a globe. Also visible are a toad, insects like a wasp, a beetle, and flies. Floral elements are present throughout the image.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 7]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image contains two large fruits at the center, surrounded by insects and plants. The color scheme is predominantly greyscale. Various floral elements, insects, and a snake-like creature are also present in the scene.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 8]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features a central elongated fish or eel-like creature surrounded by botanical and insect illustrations, including acorns, oak leaves, flowers, and bees. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white, emphasizing the intricate line work and shading of the etching. The eel-like creature curves across the center from left to right, with flowers primarily on the right and lower sections, while acorns and leaves appear on the left side. Insects are scattered throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 9]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features several large objects: a pear at the lower left, a striped snail at the bottom right, and an oversized flower in the center. The color palette is black and white, typical for an engraving, creating a high-contrast effect. Insects, such as a beetle on the pear and another on the flower, are prominent. Delicate flowers extend from the left and right edges. Latin text borders the image at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 10]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features a snake, a fruit resembling an orange, and a frog. The color palette is monochrome in shades of grey and black. In addition to the main elements, there are insects, plant forms, seeds, a shell, and a spider. Latin text is visible in two sections of the image.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 11]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features a bird in the center, facing right. Above and to the left of the bird is a moth with wings spread open. Below the bird to the left is a detailed rendering of a walnut in its husk, with various plant elements like leaves and stems around. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown, detailed linework creating texture. The bird and moth are placed centrally, surrounded by floral elements and a walnut.

artworks.title: Archetypa studiaque patris Georgii Hoefnagelii [Part 4, Plate 12]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a large butterfly in the center, with two caterpillars on flower stems on each side. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of black, white, and gray. Under the butterfly are various stages of butterfly and moth development, including chrysalises, larvae, and botanical elements like fruits, flowers, and leaves. The elements are placed around a centered, rectangular section of text.

artworks.title: Sioux Delegation
artworks.creditLine: Diana and Mallory Walker Fund

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Children
artworks.creditLine: Clinton and Jean Wright Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of two individuals: an adult woman and a child. The woman is seated upright with her head turned towards the camera. She has short, tightly-curled hair and is wrapped in a patterned fabric. She wears a beaded necklace. The child, seated next to the woman, leans against a decorative chair. The child has light-colored hair, short pants, a short-sleeved shirt, socks, and black shoes. The backdrop is plain, and the image is in an ornate golden frame.

artworks.title: a) Study of a Man Kneeling, Looking Upward (recto); b) Studies of the Same Figure (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) pen and brown ink on laid paper
b) pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: The image shows the back view of a person's upper body from head to knees. The person is kneeling with their body slightly turned to the right, arms extended upward and hands joined. The individual has wavy, shoulder-length hair. The muscular structure of their back and arms is detailed. The person is wearing a draped garment covering the lower part of their torso and falling over one leg. There are no visible accessories or objects in their hands. The background is mostly blank, with minimal sketch lines suggesting a surface or ground.

artworks.title: Lang Syne Plantation, South Carolina
artworks.creditLine: R. K. Mellon Family Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his upper body visible. He is slightly leaning forward, with his hands resting on top of each other in front of him while holding an object that appears to be a piece of cloth. His head is tilted downward, and he is gazing downward. The man's facial features include a broad nose, full lips, and closely cropped hair. He is wearing a collared, long-sleeved shirt that is buttoned up. In one hand, he holds a cigarette. The background is out of focus, featuring what appears to be a wooden structure or wall.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child with the Apple (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child. The woman has long hair, and wears a flowing garment. The child has short curly hair and sits on the woman's arm, facing the viewer with an alert expression. The background is a light-colored surface with subtle textures.

artworks.title: A Young Boy Seated Beneath a Tree
artworks.medium: red and black chalk with brush and gray and black ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from the Krugman Family Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated outdoors against a tree. The person's upper body and legs are visible. They are in a slightly reclined position with their knees bent and feet on the ground. The person's face is partially obscured by shadows, but their lips, nose, and jawline are visible. They have medium-length hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat. The person wears a long-sleeved coat, trousers, and visible shoes. Tall trees form a canopy above them, and the ground is textured with grass or earth. In the background, there are faint outlines of hills or mountains under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Steamer Magnolia at the Port of New Orleans
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a historical scene of a waterfront with a steamboat as the focal point. Viewed from a low angle, the steamboat, dock area, and people on the deck are prominent. The image has a style consistent with early photography, with soft contrast and a sepia tone. The color palette is limited to shades of brown and beige. Items like barrels and sacks on the dock indicate activity. The steamboat is moored, with its name partially visible, hinting at connections to cities like Louisville and Cincinnati. In the distance, additional structures and masts are visible against a plain sky.

artworks.title: Workshops at Washington Arsenal
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a street with a large, two-story building to the right, featuring arched windows and an entrance with people. A bare tree dominates the left side of the image, with its branches stretching upward. The road runs alongside the building, leading into the distance where smaller buildings line the street. The horizon is obscured by these distant structures, giving a sense of urban continuity. The scene is in sepia tones, with clear, crisp lines and a slightly soft focus, resembling a vintage photograph.

artworks.title: Islands, Limon Bay
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a rocky coastal scene. The perspective is low, showcasing the sandy shore and rocky outcrops dominating the view. Large rocks with trees on top stretch into the distance. The rocks have a coarse texture with visible details. The color palette is likely sepia-toned, creating a warm feel. The water around the rocks looks misty, contrasting with the solid rocks. The outlines of land or hills can be seen in the distance, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Killing the Snake
artworks.creditLine: Clinton and Jean Wright Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of two individuals seated on a rocky ledge above a scenic landscape. They appear to be engaged in conversation, with one person holding a walking stick and leaning towards the other. They are surrounded by a natural environment, with large trees framing the scene. The background includes a view of a river meandering through a valley, with rolling hills rising in the distance. In the foreground, there are some objects that appear to be part of art supplies, such as a folding stool and what may be a case, suggesting a plein air activity like painting. The photograph captures a moment of leisure and appreciation of the natural setting.

artworks.title: Arlington Mills
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image portrays a natural landscape with a river flowing over rocks. Dense foliage and a stone wall line the riverbanks. A person sits on a big rock near the water. The photograph uses a long exposure technique, creating a smooth appearance on the flowing water. The color scheme is composed mainly of sepia tones, creating a timeless and serene mood.

artworks.title: Atlantic & Great Western Railway
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a river spanning from right to left, with a low horizon featuring rolling hills in the distance. On the left side, a rocky slope descends toward the river, with a railway track beside it. A pole is in the foreground, along with a bridge or trestle structure. The scene has a sepia tone, creating a historical feel. Trees on the right lean towards the water, blending into the sky. The photograph's tones play between the darker land and trees and the lighter sky and water.

artworks.title: Atlantic & Great Western Railway
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows railway tracks extending into the distance. Along the tracks are trees, structures, and a river. A small wooden structure is near the river. The photo has a monochromatic color palette and detailed elements, giving it a timeless and deep appearance.

artworks.title: Atlantic & Great Western Railway
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a railway scene from a slightly above and left view. The setting includes leafless trees and buildings in the horizon, with curving tracks extending towards a vanishing point. A train is seen moving along a track to the right, emitting visible steam. Additional parallel tracks are detailed to the left, accompanied by a small station building. The color scheme is predominantly sepia, creating a vintage atmosphere. Various items such as barrels and supplies are visible on a platform, with an empty track bed nearby.
